title: Venue Information
summary: IEEE SSCI 2027 is proposed for the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre.

sections.heading: Conference Venue
paragraphs: The proposed venue is the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre (GCCEC), one of Australia's premier conference centres. It is centrally located in Broadbeach and is close to hotels, restaurants, the beach, and public transportation.

sections.heading: Venue Capacity and Meeting Spaces
bullets: Over 10,000 square metres of configurable event space
Main arena seating up to 6,000 participants
18 meeting rooms and boardrooms for parallel sessions, workshops, and panels
Small rooms for 20-50 seats and mid-size rooms for 100-300 seats
Foyers and exhibition areas for registration, posters, networking, and social functions

sections.heading: Technology and Hybrid Capabilities
bullets: AV-equipped rooms supporting live streaming, virtual presentations, and hybrid meetings

sections.heading: Accessibility
bullets: Wheelchair accessibility, accessible restrooms, elevators, and designated parking
Hearing loop systems in main rooms

sections.heading: Additional Amenities
bullets: Catering services, exhibitor support, business center, and lounges
Environmentally conscious operations, including Green Globe certification
Walking distance to hotels, restaurants, the beach, and public transportation
